behavior: Represent declared AI/ML/RAG metadata lineage across dataset/schema/split, preprocessing/features, training configuration, model artifact references, inference/postprocessing, evaluation, serving, or prompt/tokenizer/chunker/embedding/retrieval/index/reranker/model/tool-validation/eval/fallback stages.
Bind metadata links and drift observations to source references; preserve missing or ambiguous links as actionable gaps.
Treat unversioned remote models as observed/requested identifiers only; do not infer immutable revisions or payload details.
exclusions: No dataset rows, embeddings, checkpoints, weights, pickle/joblib payloads, notebook outputs, or model binaries may be read or deserialized.
No training-module import or execution, notebook execution, artifact download, network/provider/LLM call, or model inference.
No claim that metadata lineage guarantees model quality, reproducibility, absence of leakage, or actual serving behavior.

objective: Thêm mô hình metadata-only cho AI/ML/RAG lineage, phát hiện drift theo nguồn được khai báo và trả gap khi thiếu liên kết; tuyệt đối không nạp payload dữ liệu/model hay thực thi pipeline.
verification_plan: C067: verify source-bound links for prompt, tokenizer, embedding dimensions, dataset/split/schema, evaluation, and serving metadata drift.
Verify missing or conflicting lineage edges become gaps and do not silently join by names alone.
Use synthetic metadata only; assert no payload deserialization, model load, network access, or LLM invocation.
Run gofmt, focused Go tests, go test ./..., go vet ./..., go build ./..., SPEC and delivery-policy checks.
